## Parent disposition: complete fresh-tuple dependency is #946

#945 is audited/assembled at `007b27c488a70bb74b646b044d5c572681d9bd89`, tree `31b6ca07d1365f26faf88b74c5a93c2a1bbe9fd8`; Parent independently verified all non-doc source equals writer source `63766f9a3ad4b10562f19c874323e1b89e2ff1fc`. Its PG-only contract was respected. The remaining Redis/MinIO pins are a separate setup dependency, not a behavior/permission failure.

Parent created and exact-readback verified #946. It authorizes only the fixture's explicit expected Redis/MinIO ports, historical defaults and strict boundary tests. The same A coordinator may release the next serial offline continuation to the terminal #945 executor after its live issue/clean identity/base/settings/exclusive-slot readback. No need to wait for #945 runtime or routine Parent permission. Already-running #945 reviewers remain undisturbed; when source changes, obtain the required final exact-combined-SHA pair before #944. If that pair was not dispatched, compatible #945/#946 changes may share it.

This narrowly extends disposition 6616911598: permitted source differences from the historical #939 candidate are the reviewed #945 PG seam and #946 Redis/MinIO seams plus their boundary test. #944 itself remains evidence-only, with unchanged F16/F17 bodies/literals/production/lifecycle/reporter/selector and every cleanup criterion.

The complete static preflight also found that the preserved #944 manifest's base `auto_tm_897_939_r1` conflicts with the unchanged helper worker pattern `^auto_tm_897_938_s1r1_t[a-f0-9]{6}_w1$`. Correct the NEW manifest to base `auto_tm_897_938_s1r1` in its freshly owned PG server/project, with derived random template/_w1 names and exact matching cleanup. Prove absence before creation. Preserve the source ownership pattern; this is not another source seam or permission to reuse prior data/resources.

After final assembly/review, record all three expected port env values, the corrected base/derived worker identity, VITEST_POOL_ID1, Redis baseDB0 -> workerDB1, MinIO exact loopback/private bucket, NODE_OPTIONS tsx, built-import identities, human/default stdout+stderr and JSON destinations, and fresh exact reservation before the one governed probe. Old resource tuples/slots and foreign65379 remain excluded. Stop on a concrete mismatch; do not start a resource to discover a statically visible mismatch.

No resource, new checkout, duplicate writer, package/test/build, PR904 or B action is performed by this disposition. All actual execution updates remain the existing coordinator's responsibility.
